name: kiwi-coco-lm-base
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from answerdotai/ModernBERT-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder, alternating local (128) and global attention (every 3rd layer)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. Continued pretraining of answerdotai/ModernBERT-base with COCO-LM objectives (RTD + corrective language modelling + sequence contrastive), not a new architecture: 22 layers, 768 hidden, same 1152 intermediate. params_b is 0.161 vs the base's 0.150 for one reason - the tokenizer was rebuilt at vocab 64,000 (byte-level BPE, Korean+English) against the base's 50,368, so the tied embedding matrix is larger. Recorded as a contender because the card prints KLUE and GLUE averages with a ModernBERT row in the same tables; rows are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Card caveat: despite the 8k context, the evaluation is short sentence/paragraph classification only. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-24.

benchmarks.name: KLUE Avg (base-size models)
benchmarks.config: Card '## Evaluation' first table 'KLUE 태스크 중 일부(모델 크기 Base 기준)', Avg column: row 'Kiwi COCO-LM' 82.34 vs row 'ModernBERT' 62.36, same table. Per-task fine-tunes averaged by the author; self-reported, no harness or seed count printed. 6 of 8 KLUE tasks.

benchmarks.name: GLUE Avg
benchmarks.config: Same section, GLUE table, Avg column: this 83.02 vs ModernBERT 80.30. Base still wins SST2 95.30/93.01, CoLA 61.92/61.16, MNLI 88.73/87.64 and QNLI 93.34/93.26; the average is carried by MRPC, QQP, STS-B and RTE.
